claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST baseline, pre-training baselines (encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder pre-training), and multi-task baselines (one-to-many, many-to-one, many-to-many).
The pre-training baselines involve initializing the ST encoder from an ASR model and the decoder from an MT model, with specific training datasets mentioned.
Multi-task baselines are conducted in various settings to improve translation quality, indicating their significance in the study.
